$schema_note: L0A authoring overlay (lane/l0-authoring). SOURCE OF TRUTH for the interaction/answer-model/blocker/image metadata of all 18 Level 0A Placement Worksheet tasks. Consumed by scripts/conversion/apply-l0-overlay.ts (pnpm convert:apply-l0-overlay), which emits ONE additive migration (14 new SAM-L0A inserts) + UPDATEs for the 4 pre-existing pipeline rows (SAM-L0A-Q04/Q08/Q11/Q17) that were mis-banded KA/KB with model-reconstructed content, and appends a marker block to seed.sql. It NEVER rewrites any existing migration or generated block, and asserts every emitted statement references only SAM-L0A ids. The applier auto-injects the _authoring stub for held rows; update.content therefore omits _authoring. Mirrors the proven L2 pattern. ALL 18 tasks are Level 0A. Per the founder rule, NO 0A item is active: image-tap items are HELD-C (answer-input wiring blocker), count/oral/manual items are HELD-A / INACTIVE.

meta.band_note: Every task on this worksheet is Level 0A per the Summary table LEVEL column. The 4 pre-existing pipeline rows (Q04/Q08/Q11/Q17) were mis-banded KA/KB with model-reconstructed content; they are re-banded to 0A and their content fully replaced from the docx/crops.
meta.numbering_note: external_id SAM-L0A-Q<NN> maps to the printed task number (the number->task mapping is correct); only the model-reconstructed CONTENT was wrong and is re-authored here.
meta.active_policy_note: Founder rule: every ACTIVE item must be auto-gradeable from text alone; any item whose answer depends on an unseen picture stays inactive. On 0A the entire worksheet is picture/manual/oral, so there are 0 active items. Image-tap items are HELD-C (the binding blocker is the un-wired click-image interaction); the count-the-balloons item is HELD-A (format wired, answer depends on the picture).
meta.image_note: Per-question art is uploaded by the founder later to the private question-images Supabase bucket. We do NOT set image_path here. content.image_alt is required and deliberately NON-revealing (must not leak the answer). The source crop filename is recorded in authoring.image for the founder's upload step; for HELD-A the crop is also listed in authoring.image per task brief.
